# hvir

hvir is a cross-platform desktop workbench for developers who live in the terminal.
It combines fast embedded terminals, git worktree workflows, remote SSH
workspaces, a rich file and document viewer, and first-class integration with
AI coding agents ("harnesses") in a single Electron application.

## Features

- **Embedded terminals** – GPU-accelerated terminals powered by
  [`ghostty-web`](https://github.com/jarmak-personal/ghostty-web) with a native
  [`node-pty`](https://github.com/microsoft/node-pty) backend, split layouts,
  and per-terminal attention badges.
- **Git-aware workspaces** – Browse the working tree, review changes, switch
  branches, fetch/pull, and manage worktrees from a dedicated git panel and
  commit graph.
- **Remote workspaces over SSH** – Open and work in projects hosted on remote
  machines using [`ssh2`](https://github.com/mscdex/ssh2) and SSH config
  resolution.
- **Document review & file viewer** – View and diff files with CodeMirror,
  Shiki syntax highlighting, Markdown (including task lists) and Mermaid
  diagram rendering.
- **AI harness integration** – Connect coding-agent sessions with context
  presentation, telemetry, and document-review insertion contracts.
- **Sessions & diagnostics** – Track sessions, workbench health, and runtime
  diagnostics across the app.

## Requirements

- **Node.js** `>= 24`
- A supported desktop platform: **macOS** or **Linux** (Debian-based packages
  are produced for distribution)

## Getting started

Install dependencies. The `postinstall` step rebuilds native modules

# hvir

hvir is a cross-platform desktop workbench for developers who live in the terminal.
It combines fast embedded terminals, git worktree workflows, remote SSH
workspaces, a rich file and document viewer, and first-class integration with
AI coding agents ("harnesses") in a single Electron application.

## Features

- **Embedded terminals** – GPU-accelerated terminals powered by
  [`ghostty-web`](https://github.com/jarmak-personal/ghostty-web) with a native
  [`node-pty`](https://github.com/microsoft/node-pty) backend, split layouts,
  and per-terminal attention badges.
- **Git-aware workspaces** – Browse the working tree, review changes, switch
  branches, fetch/pull, and manage worktrees from a dedicated git panel and
  commit graph.
- **Remote workspaces over SSH** – Open and work in projects hosted on remote
  machines using [`ssh2`](https://github.com/mscdex/ssh2) and SSH config
  resolution.
- **Document review & file viewer** – View and diff files with CodeMirror,
  Shiki syntax highlighting, Markdown (including task lists) and Mermaid
  diagram rendering.
- **AI harness integration** – Connect coding-agent sessions with context
  presentation, telemetry, and document-review insertion contracts.
- **Sessions & diagnostics** – Track sessions, workbench health, and runtime
  diagnostics across the app.

- **Node.js** `>= 24`

  are produced for distribution)
